title: Boundary-First Engineering

hero.headline: Extract the boundary before optimizing the inside.
hero.support: A systems-engineering practice for discovering actors, distinctions, invariants, interfaces, failure states, responsibility, and closure conditions before implementation hardens them accidentally.

sections.heading: Own the problem complexity
sections.body: Do not create code complexity to compensate for an insufficient model of the domain.

sections.heading: Build the delivery skeleton
sections.body: Clear the executable path from uncertainty to delivered artifact and expose blockers early.

sections.heading: Make invariants explicit
sections.body: Architecture should preserve declared domain conditions across execution, composition, deployment, failure, and repair.

sections.heading: Let certainty meet execution
sections.body: Work is ready when domain certainty and executable implementation meet at the correct granularity.

sections.heading: Treat defects structurally
sections.body: A bug is one observable instance of a deeper failure relative to an expected invariant, boundary, or closure condition.
